implement.instruction: Read the GitHub Issue identified by run_input in github_repository using available tools, then implement it completely in the assigned worktree. Run relevant tests. Do not push, open pull requests, or comment.

publish.instruction: Create the pull request for the Issue identified by run_input in github_repository, or update it if inputs[0].data.pr already identifies one. Commit any uncommitted changes, push this worktree's HEAD to a branch, and write the title and body following the repository's conventions and pull request template, linking the Issue. Do not merge. Return the PR identity.

pr.description: The pull request this Run publishes; forward it unchanged unless it changes.

head_sha.description: Commit SHA currently at the PR head on GitHub.

review.instruction: Review the pull request in inputs[0].data.pr against the Issue identified by run_input: check both missing scope and unnecessary scope, correctness, and tests. Leave files unchanged; do not push or merge. Forward pr unchanged.

pr.description: The pull request this Run publishes; forward it unchanged unless it changes.

head_sha.description: Commit SHA currently at the PR head on GitHub.

approved.description: True only when no blocking review findings remain.

findings.description: Blocking problems that must be fixed before approval.

fix.instruction: Fix the findings in inputs[0].data.findings in the assigned worktree and run relevant tests. Do not push or merge. Forward inputs[0].data.pr unchanged and summarize the fixes.

pr.description: The pull request this Run publishes; forward it unchanged unless it changes.

head_sha.description: Commit SHA currently at the PR head on GitHub.

merge.instruction: Merge the pull request in inputs[0].data.pr only if its head is still inputs[0].data.pr.head_sha, following repository conventions and GitHub policy. Do not bypass required checks or reviews. Forward pr.

pr.description: The pull request this Run publishes; forward it unchanged unless it changes.

head_sha.description: Commit SHA currently at the PR head on GitHub.

close_issue.instruction: If inputs[0].data.merged is true, make sure the Issue identified by run_input in github_repository is closed, referencing the merged pull request in inputs[0].data.pr. Otherwise leave it open. Report whether it is closed.
